biography.plain_text: Samantha Sophia Hunt, also known as Samantha Sackler Hunt, is an Austrian philanthropic trustee and former pharmaceutical-company director. She helps govern two family foundations that make grants to other charitable organisations, supporting health, cultural, scientific and general public-benefit work. Her public career links long-running family philanthropy with earlier board service at Napp Pharmaceuticals.

long_biography.plain_text:
Napp Pharmaceutical Group was Samantha Sophia Hunt's principal public business role for more than two decades. She joined its board in 1995, also served its holding company and left both roles in 2017. As one of its Class A directors, her approval was required for key group decisions.

Hunt now serves as trustee of two family grant-making foundations. Both support other organisations rather than operating their own programmes. At a rare public appearance for a Serpentine gallery opening funded by her family, she described the building as her father Mortimer's final gift. She also said she was proud of his legacy.
